title: Astra Surge
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -10 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: This is a continuous excerpt from the MIDDLE of an already-playing full-volume chorus, not a song opening. The first beat and last beat both have complete drums, bass, chords and pitched hook at strong normal level. No gradual energy or volume ramp. Create one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo MELODIC TRANCE instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 138 BPM in 4/4. A full uplifting four-on-the-floor groove at time zero: clean strong kick on every quarter beat, crisp clap on two and four, eighth hats, short plucked arpeggio attack on each quarter beat, round bass and warm wide chords. Maintain clear attacks and stable energy to the last beat. Signature hook: five ascending staccato notes converge on one sustained high tone, then a lower two-note answer returns to the root. At 64 seconds keep the groove and level, change chord roots, let the five-note figure descend and use a new higher response phrase. No quiet intro, slow build, half-time switch, filtered outro, fade, silent tail, tempo drift, abrasive distortion, vocals, speech, samples, known melody or imitation of another song.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Create one original SQUARE 1:1 duohertz cover for Astra Surge, an all-ages trance rhythm-game track. Original near-black editorial comic-print cut-paper style with warm ivory, electric cyan, coral red and sparse halftone. Keep every named motif element inside the central 55% width and y=25–68% of the square for a narrow 100px mobile crop, with dark lower fifth for the local title overlay. Flat graphic, no realistic scenery, people, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, strobe or copied game art. Main motif: ONE asymmetrical five-point warm-ivory starburst made of cut paper, with exactly THREE short cyan sound arcs expanding only from its lower right point, ONE coral stepped pulse line passing through the center and a tiny warm-yellow diamond at the point of impact. Keep it abstract and musical, unlike a compass, sun, fireworks, crest or astronomy scene.
art_provenance.og_prompt: Edit the supplied Astra Surge square cover into a HORIZONTAL roughly 1.9:1 duohertz social card. Preserve the single five-point ivory starburst, exactly three cyan arcs from its lower-right point, one coral stepped pulse through the center and one tiny yellow diamond. Recompose the complete motif on the RIGHT half over near-black comic-print ink with sparse halftone, leaving calm dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp fully legible English lines at left: 'duohertz' lowercase electric cyan and 'Astra Surge' larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly, no truncation. Purpose-build the wide composition; do not stretch the square. No other text, scenery, people, logo, watermark or copied game art.
